verdict.rationale: Framer's own docs show responsive layout work: the canvas exposes breakpoints and spacing, and the agent adapts layouts across tablet and phone breakpoints by adjusting stacks, type sizes and spacing. That covers the responsive-frames core, with stacks roughly matching auto layout, but constraints and grid resizing behavior are never documented, and the evidence leans on the AI agent rather than on manual frame controls. Missing for 10: documented constraints/pinning behavior, responsive grid layout docs, explicit auto-layout frame controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, frames can behave responsively — auto layout, constraints, and grids resize designs the way real UIs flex

citations.quote: It adapts your layouts across breakpoints, adjusting stacks, type sizes, spacing, and image crops until everything works.
use the Framer canvas to refine layouts, typography, components, breakpoints, spacing, color, and effects
